description:
Explorer thumbnails for 334 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.

SageThumbs 2K is a modern, crash-isolated Windows 11 shell extension written in Rust that rebuilds the classic SageThumbs. It gives File Explorer thumbnails for 334 file types Windows can't preview on its own — camera RAW, HEIC/AVIF, Photoshop, DjVu, ebooks and comics, video frames, 3D-print files and a long tail of obscure formats — plus a right-click image toolkit (convert, resize, rotate, OCR, color picker, metadata strip, combine-to-PDF/CBZ) and a console/AI CLI. Free for personal use.
## What's changed

### Fixed

- **An email that has been copied around now still previews as an email.** Some tools rewrite
  line endings when they copy a file, which doubles the invisible marker that separates an
  email's headers from its message. SageThumbs was strict about that marker, so a mail that had
  been through such a tool opened as raw source text instead of as a message. It now reads
  either form.
